text: The paper reports that on arithmetic, with debate length fixed at two rounds, performance increases monotonically with the number of agents (larger groups use ChatGPT summaries of other responses due to context length). With three agents, performance increases monotonically with rounds, but more than four rounds gave performance similar to four rounds.
title: More agents and more debate rounds raise arithmetic accuracy, saturating near 4 rounds
